misconceptions.name: 有 since 却用了一般过去时
misconceptions.why: 看到“发生了变化”就用过去式，没注意 since 要配现在完成时。
misconceptions.move: 圈出 since 2015，问：说的是从那时一直到现在吗？到现在就用 have done。

misconceptions.name: take place 用了被动语态
misconceptions.why: 觉得变化是“被带来的”，不知道 take place、happen 不带宾语，不能用被动。
misconceptions.move: 问：变化是被谁“发生”的吗？take place、happen 不带宾语，没有被动语态。

misconceptions.name: 复数主语用了 has
misconceptions.why: 只顾判断时态，没回头看主语 changes 是复数。
misconceptions.move: 圈出主语 changes，问：一个还是很多？复数主语用 have。

misconceptions.name: 现在完成时配了过去时间点
misconceptions.why: 把汉语的“开了”“变了”都译成现在完成时，没注意 two years ago 是过去的一个时间点。
misconceptions.move: 画时间轴：two years ago、last year、in 2018 是过去的一个点，用一般过去时；since、for 连到现在，才用 have done。

misconceptions.name: used to 后接了 doing
misconceptions.why: 把 used to do 和 be used to doing 混在一起了。
misconceptions.move: 对比：used to ride（过去常骑）/ is used to riding（习惯于骑），先看前面有没有 be。

misconceptions.name: used to 后用了过去式
misconceptions.why: used 已经是过去式，就以为后面的动词也要变。
misconceptions.move: 提醒：to 后面用动词原形，“过去”已经由 used 表示了。

misconceptions.name: 长词重复了 more 和形容词
misconceptions.why: 把 taller and taller 的格式照搬到了长词上。
misconceptions.move: 板书两种格式：短词 taller and taller；长词 more and more beautiful。

lessons: What changes have taken place around you
items.stem: Great changes ____ in my hometown since 2015.
right: since 2015 说的是从那时到现在，用现在完成时；
主语 changes 是复数，用 have；take place 没有被动。
typical: 变化是“被带来的”，要用被动：

ladder.q: My town ____ (change) a lot in the past ten years.
What ____ (happen) to your hometown since you left?
改错：A big change has been taken place in my school.

lessons: What changes have taken place around you
items.stem: 小明这样写家乡的变化。你同意吗？
work: A big supermarket has opened in my village two years ago.
right: two years ago 是过去的一个时间点，要用一般过去时：
A big supermarket opened in my village two years ago.

ladder.q: My hometown ____ (change) a lot since I was a child.
The new bridge ____ (open) last year, and many people ____ (use) it since then.

lessons: What changes have taken place around you
items.stem: 用括号里的词填空：My grandpa used to ____ (ride) a bike to work. Now he takes the subway.
right: used to + 动词原形，表示过去常常做、现在不做了：
typical: used 是过去式，后面也用过去式：rode

ladder.q: There used to ____ (be) a river here.
用 used to 改写：Tom often played football, but he doesn't now.
改成一般疑问句：He used to walk to school.
ladder.a: Did he use to walk to school?

right: “越来越……”用“比较级 and 比较级”；
长词写成 more and more + 原级：more and more beautiful。
typical: 照着 taller and taller 的样子：

ladder.q: The days are getting ____ (long).（越来越长）
The story is getting ____ (interesting).（越来越有趣）
Life in our village is getting ____ (good).（越来越好）
